progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on F in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:06.6) introduces Bb, C, centred on C. Phrase 6 (0:49.3) introduces Ab, centred on F. The line peaks at C5 (562.5 Hz) at 0:44.7. It closes on the tonic (Ab4 → F4 → G4 → Ab4 → F3 → F3).
